admission.justification: The notice is produced from the resolver's pair and rendered only by the page's own note and comparison-menu parts, so a reader-facing promise about which comparison is on screen rests on both sides of that boundary and is proven by the resolver test and the mounted-page cases.

applicability: The review page and its leaf-wide read for a landed leaf whose enclosure records a delivery.
conditions: The line names the shown number and the delivered code and memory trees, and offers the delivered view only when that pair was established.
The delivered view is the page's own default, so following the link clears the chosen number and leaves any recorded frame.
A matching pair states no line, and is not marked as moved merely because it was recorded earlier.
exclusions: A new comparison namespace, a second review surface or a semantic verdict about the shown or delivered pair.
A failed notice read rendered as a matching delivery; it is stated unavailable with no delivered control.
A line that implies a historical record's own count or statement was erroneous.
statement: A review whose comparison is not the pair its leaf delivered states that once, naming the delivered code and memory trees and offering the delivered view, while a matching pair states nothing and a delivery that cannot be established is named unavailable.
